display_title: [Issue #8265] Fixed different filter behavior.

head_commit.message:
[Issue #8265] Fixed different filter behavior.

The difference in filter behavior documented in #8265 was due to the difference in the selection toggle functions declared in `CheckboxFilter.tsx` (functioning correctly) and in `RadioButtonFilter.tsx` (minimal functionality). Two changes were made to fix the behavior of `RadioButtonFilter.tsx` to mirror `CheckboxFilter.tsx`

> 1: In `src/components/search/SearchFilterRadio.tsx` the toggle selection function was assigned to an `onChange` prompt. This caused issues since the toggle selection function was not getting triggered the second time for the selected radio button because nothing was being changed to trigger the event handler. An `onClick` prop was added to fix this issue and the `toggleRadioSelection` function was changed to take `React.MouseEvent` instead of `React.ChangeEvent`.

> 2: The `toggleRadioSelection` function was changed to de-select the clicked radio button and assign empty string as the value for `setQueryParam()`. This causes the default radio button to be selected.

head_commit.message:
[Issue #8976] Add org saved opportunity email notification task (#9703)

## Summary

<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Fixes #8976

## Changes proposed

<!-- What was added, updated, or removed in this PR. -->
Implements `OrgSavedOpportunityNotificationTask`, a task that emails
organization members when new opportunities are saved to their org
Integrates the new task into the existing EmailNotificationTask runner
behind a `ENABLE_ORG_SAVED_OPPORTUNITY_NOTIFICATIONS` feature flag
(default false)
Enables the flag in dev and staging environments via Terraform config

## Context for reviewers

<!-- Technical or background context, more in-depth details of the
implementation, and anything else you'd like reviewers to know about
that will help them understand the changes in the PR. -->
We want to create a new email notification task for when new
opportunities have been saved to organizations that a user is a member
of. We will need to implement a new notification class derived from the
[base notification
class](https://github.com/HHS/simpler-grants-gov/blob/main/api/src/task/notifications/base_notification.py)
and add that new organization saved opportunity notification task to be
run under the EmailNotificationTask class
[here](https://github.com/HHS/simpler-grants-gov/blob/2977d3387db9cb07bbd5750bed4d7bdbae7c6eac/api/src/task/notifications/email_notification.py#L43)

The task:
Queries all `organization_saved_opportunity` rows where
notification_processed_at IS NULL
Groups by org, finds eligible members (org notifications enabled, email
not suppressed)
Marks rows as processed (notification_processed_at = now) before sending
Aggregates across orgs so users in multiple orgs receive a single email
Truncates to 5 opportunities per org with a "and N more..." link to
/saved-opportunities

## Validation steps

<!-- Manual testing instructions, as well as any helpful references
(screenshots, GIF demos, code examples or output). -->
See unit test coverage. 

For local confirmation:
Make sure db is up to date.

Run:
```
make console

user = f.UserFactory.create()
f.LinkExternalUserFactory.create(user=user, email="your-real-email@example.com")
org = f.OrganizationFactory.create(sam_gov_entity=None)
f.OrganizationUserFactory.create(organization=org, user=user)
f.UserSavedOpportunityNotificationFactory.create(user=user, organization=org, email_enabled=True)
opp = f.OpportunityFactory.create()
f.OrganizationSavedOpportunityFactory.create(organization=org, opportunity=opp)
dbs.commit()
```

Ensure `RESET_EMAILS_WITHOUT_SENDING=false` is set in
`api/override.env`, then run the task:
```
docker compose run --rm -e ENABLE_ORG_SAVED_OPPORTUNITY_NOTIFICATIONS=true grants-api poetry run flask task email-notifications
```
Confirm`notification_processed_at` is set on the row (email won't be
received sending locally).

Expected log output:
```
Processing org saved opportunity notifications  organization_id=... opportunity_count=1 eligible_member_count=1
Successfully delivered notification to user     pinpoint_delivery_status=SUCCESSFUL pinpoint_status_code=200
Completed OrgSavedOpportunityNotificationTask   org_saved_opportunities_tracked=1 users_notified=1
```

Re-run the task and confirm no second email is sent (users_notified=0,
notifications_reset=0).
